def solve(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    category_avg = df.group_by("category").agg(pl.col("amount").mean())
    result = df.join(
        category_avg,
        on="category",
        how="left",
        strategy="semi"
    ).filter(pl.col("amount") > pl.col("category_avg"))
    return result

        share=(pl.col("amount") / total).alias("share")
    ).select(["category", "share"])

def solve(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    total = df.group_by("group").agg(pl.col("amount").sum())
    result = df.join(
        total,
        on="group",
        how="left",
        suffixes=("", "_total")
    )
    result = result.with_columns(
        (pl.col("amount") / pl.col("amount_total")).alias("pct_of_group")
    )
    return result
```

def solve(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    max_sales = df.group_by("region").agg(pl.col("sales").max())
    df = df.join(max_sales, on="region", how="left")
    df = df.with_columns(
        (pl.col("sales") / pl.col("max_sales")).alias("vs_best")
    )
    return df

def solve(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    result = df.clone()
    result = result.with_columns(
        pl.col("value").rank(dense=True, method="min").over("group").alias("rnk"),
        (pl.col("value") == pl.col("value").max().over("group")).alias("is_top"),
    )
    return result

def solve(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    df = df.with_columns(pl.col("d").cast(pl.Date))
    result = (
        df
        .group_by("d")
        .agg(pl.col("amount").sum().alias("amount"))
        .sort("d")
        .with_columns(
            pl.col("d").dt.to_datetime().dt.truncate("month").dt.strftime("%Y-%m").alias("month")
        )
        .drop("d")
    )
    return result

def solve(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    df = df.with_columns(
        pl.col("d").cast(pl.Date),
        pl.col("user").over("d").rank(method="min", order="descending").over("user").alias("prev_rank"),
        pl.col("d").over("user").shift(1).fill_null(None).alias("prev_d"),
    )
    df = df.with_columns(
        (pl.col("d") - pl.col("prev_d")).dt.days().alias("gap_days")
    )
    df = df.drop("prev_rank", "prev_d")
    return df
```
